newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB reviewing rates after RBA easing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB reviewing rates after RBA easing.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd is reviewing its interest rates after the Reserve Bank cut the official cash rate by 50 basis points earlier on Wednesday, a spokesman for the bank said.
"We are reviewing rates today and we will advise people today," spokesman David Upton told Reuters.

Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd and the Commonwealth Bank of Australia Ltd announced 50-basis-point cuts in their variable home loan interest rates to 8.75 percent immediately after the cut in the cash rate.
